name: Cloud Impostor Rendering
definition: A technique to accelerate cloud rendering by replacing geometric particle models with 2D texture impostors, exploiting the lack of high-frequency edges in clouds to tolerate lower resolution textures and frequent updates.
summary: Cloud Impostor Rendering accelerates cloud visualization by replacing particle models with dynamically generated 2D texture impostors, exploiting clouds' lack of high-frequency edges to tolerate lower resolutions and frequent updates.
